items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 18 May 2026 3:29pm
items.description:
##Today##

Early showers soon clearing to leave a mostly dry & bright day with sunny spells. Rain arriving this evening, turning heavier overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 13°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

7-12


##Wind Speed##

10


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 5-10, backing S or SE this evening. Becoming SE 20-25, locally 25-30, overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times tonight. Hill fog later.


##Comments##

Strong wind overnight. Risk of minor coastal overtopping around time of high tide (1:30am).


##Tomorrow##

Outbreaks of rain at first, soon clearing to bright intervals and scattered showers.


##Temperature##

25

S

##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in precipitation. Hill fog, especially at first.


##Comments##

Strong winds until later. Risk of minor coastal overtopping around time of high tide (2pm).
